summary: Romero's campaign messaging centers on combating antisemitism on California campuses. In October 2026, she tagged AIPAC and pro-Israel organizations while calling for votes to 'end antisemitism in California schools, colleges,' framing October 7 as a rallying point. Her platform calls for holding university administrators accountable for campus non-discrimination, specifically naming Jewish students. JNS reported she centers her campaign on antisemitism 'rather than Gaza policy.' This alignment positions her as a defender of Israel.
